M. American$$QGilbert, C. M. American — Date: 1895 January 12
family-portrait.collection: Theodore Roosevelt Collection, Houghton Library, Harvard University.
family-portrait.crop_note: Cropped to the photograph: the cabinet-card mount, with C. M. Gilbert's signature on it, has been cut off.
family-portrait.credit_line: Theodore and Edith Roosevelt with Alice, Ted, Kermit, Ethel and the infant Archie, photographed by C. M. Gilbert, January 1895. Theodore Roosevelt Collection, Houghton Library, Harvard University.
family-portrait.note: FIVE children, not six. Quentin was born in 1897, two years after this sitting. An alt text reading 'six children' has been corrected once already.

edith-portrait.description: [Edith Kermit Carow Roosevelt, three-quarter length portrait, seated on bench, facing right] — 1 photographic print. — Creator: Johnston, Frances Benjamin — Date: 1902
edith-portrait.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
edith-portrait.crop_note: Cropped to the picture: the black negative-carrier border and the white margin carrying the pencilled reproduction number 104524 have been cut off.
edith-portrait.credit_line: Théobald Chartran's 1902 portrait of Edith Kermit Roosevelt, photographed by Frances Benjamin Johnston. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
edith-portrait.note: NOT a photographic portrait. LOC records this as a photoprint by Frances Benjamin Johnston OF A PAINTING by Théobald Chartran; the LOC catalogue title, which reads as a description of a sitter, has misled captions before. Credit it as a painting.
